ai_summary: Ambuja Cements, a key Adani portfolio company, reported a challenging Q2 FY27 with a significant material impact from geopolitical tensions (West Asia War) which drove up energy and logistics costs. This resulted in a substantial 28% year-over-year decline in EBITDA and a sharp 90% drop in reported Profit After Tax, indicating considerable operational headwinds despite aggressive long-term capacity expansion plans (targeting 155 MTPA) and corporate simplification efforts. While the company maintains a debt-free balance sheet and strong credit ratings, the high capital expenditure for growth, coupled with these operational pressures, led to a net decrease in cash, highlighting near-term financial strain amidst ambitious strategic initiatives.
